name: web-industrial-product-detail-page-system
title: Product detail page for a catalog site: desktop, mobile and dark footer
whatItIs: A lilac-blue board titled 'Product card' with a long desktop product page (gallery with thumbnails, key facts, price box with two buttons, tabs, specification table, warranty note, dark navy footer with columns), a long mobile version and two more phone screens for extra services and an expanded menu.
whatItMeans: Thorough and dependable; ordered tables and consistent blue actions convey professional supply.
techniques: Split product info into a gallery, facts and a sticky price box.
Use tabs under the fold to divide description, reviews, services and delivery.
Present specs as a two-column table with hairlines.
End with a dark navy multi-column footer for contrast.
Show the mobile page as one long scroll next to smaller state screens.

vocabulary.definition: A two-column list of attributes and values.
A panel holding price, unit toggle and buy buttons.
